x1.description: Input array, only accepts unsigned integer subtypes
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

x2.description: The amount of bits to shift each element in ``x1`` to the right, only accepts integer subtypes
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: An array-like object containing the right shifted elements of ``x1`` by the amount specified in ``x2``, with the same shape as the broadcasted shape of ``x1`` and ``x2``.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes
